environment.description: ECS Fargate service behind an Application Load Balancer in us-east-1. The ALB has a single listener on port 443 forwarding to the target group. No AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The service runs in a private subnet with NAT gateway for outbound. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and port 8080 from ALB SG on the task. The container runs as non-root with read-only root filesystem except /tmp where the SQLite DB resides. API keys are provisioned via environment variables injected from Secrets Manager.
